description: Create a system announcement in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus. Navigate to Home > Announcements and create a new announcement with the following details: Title: 'Planned Network Maintenance - Saturday 2AM to 6AM', Content: 'IT Infrastructure team will be performing scheduled network maintenance on Saturday from 2:00 AM to 6:00 AM. Internet and VPN services will be unavailable during this window. Please save all work before 2 AM. Apologies for any inconvenience.'. Log in with username: administrator, password: administrator.
